explanation: One composite macro gate replaces separate drawdown, recovery, and volatility alerts. It requires Phase 1 early recovery and high realized volatility to be true together.

Positive and unusually high short-underlying minus long beta indicates that a market rebound can squeeze the recent-loser leg. Threshold: prior-only 80th percentile from 728 observations; raw historical threshold=-0.000593827; overridden by structural floor=0; active threshold=0.

Long-short wealth relative to its highest level in the prior 63 trading days is compared with its own prior-only left-tail history. The threshold can never be looser than -20%, and drawdowns shallower than 5% are not material. Threshold: prior-only 20th percentile from 728 observations; raw historical threshold=-0.144531.

Trailing 21-day short loss magnitude is the sum of negative signed short contributions. It triggers only when Phase 1 early recovery is active and the loss reaches the threshold. Threshold: prior-only 80th percentile from 770 observations; raw historical threshold=0.153702.
